info.name: ilert REST Alert Actions Reports API
List alert metrics for the requested resources

params.name: sources
params.description: alert source ids to filter metrics for

params.name: policies
params.description: escalation policy ids to filter metrics for

params.name: numbers
params.description: phone numbers of call routing numbers to filter metrics for

params.name: from
params.description: date-time ISO-UTC e.g. 2021-05-25T21:24:56.771Z, start of the time range, may not exceed 1 year in total span

params.name: until
params.description: date-time ISO-UTC e.g. 2021-05-25T21:24:56.771Z, end of the time range, must be after 'from', must not be in the future

params.name: timezone
params.description: Time zone in which the results will be rendered, defaults to tenant's configured default timezone

params.name: metric
params.description: Describes the metric that should be fetched choose one of: COUNT, MTTA or MTTR - defaults to COUNT

params.name: group-by
params.description: Defines the grouping of metrics, choose one of: DAY, WEEK or MONTH - defaults to WEEK

params.name: priority
params.description: Sets the priority filter that should be applied, choose one of: LOW, HIGH or ALL - defaults to ALL

items.docs: List alert metrics for the requested resources
